bundle.shortDescription: Display public-domain paintings while AI agents work
bundle.longDescription: ArtBreak displays one public-domain painting from The Met when Claude Code or Codex is working for at least two seconds.

security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://collectionapi.metmuseum.org; img-src 'self' https://images.metmuseum.org; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'
